none: PAS NLM-9F7897: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Valentinian from Crowle
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of House of Valentinian, Securitas Rei Publicae issue of 364-378, Reece period 19. Obverse description: Worn away. Reverse description: Victory advancing left. Reverse inscription: [SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE]. Diameter: 15.4mm, Weight: 1.47gms
